title: DC-area forecast: Warm, muggy tonight. Storm chances are back for the workweek.
contentHtml:
Always a human at the helm: Updated around-the-clock by Capital Weather meteorologists.

Happening now: Mostly clear and muggy as evening 70s to near 80 dip to overnight lows near 70 to the mid-70s.

What's next? Staying hot and humid Monday and Tuesday as the chance for some storms makes a comeback. Perhaps less warm as the week progresses, but a few severe storms are possible Monday through Wednesday.

Forecast in detail

Tonight: Mainly clear, just warm and muggy. Lows near 70 to the mid-70s as dew points stay up near 70. Confidence: High

Hourly Forecast | Pollen, Air & UV

Tomorrow (Monday): Feeling like August but the heat and humidity are a bit above average. Highs in the low to mid-90s feel around 100 with dew points around 70. Skies are fairly sunny before storm chances rise by late afternoon, especially after 3 or 4 p.m., although models are quite mixed as to whether we may see just a couple of isolated storms or more numerous scattered storms. If storms do form, some could produce damaging winds. Confidence: Medium

Tomorrow night: A chance of isolated to scattered showers and storms continues during the evening, especially before 9 p.m. A few showers remain possible into the predawn hours. Muggy lows in the low to mid-70s with partly cloudy skies outside of any rain. Confidence: Medium

📬 Get our forecast in your inbox

Our morning forecast email is back! It's included with every level of support — from Free to Sustainer — delivered 7 days a week. Sign up at: capitalweather.com/support-us

A look ahead

There's not much of a change in the forecast for Tuesday. Skies should be partly to mostly sunny with highs in the upper 80s to mid-90s and still humid. Radar could light up during the afternoon to evening with isolated to scattered showers or thunderstorms. Confidence: Medium

Wednesday and Thursday shouldn't be quite as hot, with highs looking like the mid-80s to near 90, and humidity may come down a little by Thursday. Scattered late-day showers and storms are possible both days, with a growing chance of a few strong to severe storms as a cold front approaches. Confidence: Low-Medium

Far from certain, but it's possible the front comes through and knocks humidity down (yay!) for Friday and the weekend with cooler highs in the 80s.

Today’s daily digit — 4/10: Stuck in the dog days of summer with heat and high humidity, although we get a brief break from significant storm chances today. | 🤚 Your call?
The digit is a somewhat subjective rating of the day’s weather, on a 0-to-10 scale.

DC weather history for August 9

A brutal 1930 heat wave and historic drought brought triple-digit temperatures and parched rivers, marking one of the most severe dry spells ever observed in the region.
